instruction: Find out how to enable and permanently set search result highlighting in Vim, so that matches are automatically highlighted when searching.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: This variation requires searching for Vim search highlighting configuration and modifying .vimrc to add 'set hlsearch' or 'set hls'. The evaluator checks if the configuration file contains the hlsearch setting using a bash script that searches for the appropriate configuration line.
metadata.verification: The evaluator script checks if .vimrc contains 'hlsearch' or 'set hls', which are the standard commands to enable search result highlighting in Vim. This is a well-documented Vim feature with consistent behavior across versions.

llm_judge_reasons: The fixed eval.sh correctly excludes commented lines (lines starting with '"' in Vim)
The fixed eval.sh correctly distinguishes between 'set hlsearch'/'set hls' (enabling) and 'set nohlsearch'/'set nohls' (disabling)
The fixed eval.sh correctly uses the last occurrence of hlsearch-related settings to handle multiple conflicting settings
The metric function correctly handles the 'expected' parameter for type='rule' (directly accesses 'include' and 'exclude' keys)
The evaluator correctly verifies the main requirement: permanent hlsearch configuration in .vimrc
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor enhancement: Consider supporting 'setlocal hlsearch' in addition to 'set hlsearch' (though 'set' is the standard global setting)
Minor enhancement: Consider handling edge case of ':set hlsearch' with colon prefix (though this is rare in .vimrc files)
validation.fix_summary: Updated eval.sh to: 1) Exclude commented lines (lines starting with '"' in Vim), 2) Explicitly check for and exclude 'set nohlsearch' and 'set nohls', 3) Use the last occurrence of hlsearch-related settings to handle cases where multiple conflicting settings exist, 4) Use symmetric and precise patterns to match both 'set hlsearch' and 'set hls' while excluding disabled variants
